# PATCH

Fixes slide navigation inside rotated containers, where navigation could stop short and leave the selected slide clipped.

- Preserves alignment with fractional slide widths, gaps, borders, padding, and margins.
- Supports rotated containers with scaling, responsive layouts, and right-to-left navigation.
- Adds `loop="continuous"` for seamless navigation and autoplay with static images and text.

Finite navigation and `loop={true}` endpoint wrapping keep their existing behavior. No migration steps are required.
